name: Pigment violet 32
description: Pigment Violet 32 (CAS 12225-08-0 ), also sold under the trade name Permanent Bordeaux HF3R, is a high-performance organic pigment delivering deep bordeaux-to-violet shades across demanding industrial colorant applications. It belongs to the benzimidazolone pigment class, a family recognized for strong heat stability and resistance to migration. These properties directly influence grade selection for processors working across multiple substrates. In plastics compounding, it withstands processing temperatures required for engineering polymers. This makes it a reliable choice for masterbatch and colored compound production where thermal stability is a primary concern. Printing ink formulators use it in packaging applications where bleed resistance and lightfastness are critical. These characteristics ensure that finished products meet strict brand color standards over their entire lifecycle. Coatings manufacturers incorporate it into industrial and decorative finishes where bordeaux and violet tones must retain depth. It is particularly effective under outdoor or chemical exposure where other pigments might fade. Textile and paper colorant producers also apply it where consistent hue strength is required. It offers excellent substrate compatibility across batch production, ensuring uniformity in large-scale manufacturing environments. The product is supplied as a dry powder, the standard commercial form for pigment dispersion into resins and inks. It is available in technical and industrial grades to suit various manufacturing requirements. Particle size and surface treatment specifications vary by supplier to suit specific dispersion needs.
